# Untimed lyrics with a song-part tag in front of their words (fix/lrc145): the tag must not float in the sky with them.
# Run it twice, on the branch and on main, and compare:
# Run: gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=fix/lrc145 -f script=.github/checks/lrc145.txt
#      gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=main -f script=.github/checks/lrc145.txt
#
# The two made-up lines are untimed ("plain"), spread over the 78 s demo: the first from 6.5 s, the second from 42 s.
# plain-tag-lines-1 (Lines layout): main shows "[Chorus] Lanterns drift over the town"; the branch shows
#   "Lanterns drift over the town" with no bracket.
# plain-tag-lines-2: main shows "[Verse 1: Someone] Glow on until the morning"; the branch "Glow on until the morning".
# plain-tag-world-1 / -2 (World layout): the same words as floating cards; on main the first card reads "[Chorus]" or
#   "[Verse" and "1:" and "Someone]" come as cards of their own; on the branch every card is a sung word.
# The lyrics shown are untimed, so the top bar and the Record card show no line on either: that is expected.
# (The other fix on the branch, a line stamped before the song's start, can't be shown here: the test hook only plays
#  lines stamped from 0 s on. Its tests are LrcNegativeStampTest and OddLrcFilesTest.)

cmd weather clear
cmd time set midnight
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
look 0 -20
sleep 6
plain [Chorus] Lanterns drift over the town | [Verse 1: Someone] Glow on until the morning
seek 9
sleep 3
shot plain-tag-lines-1
seek 45
sleep 3
shot plain-tag-lines-2
set layout WORLD
look 0 0
seek 7
sleep 5
shot plain-tag-world-1
seek 43
sleep 5
shot plain-tag-world-2
